decisions.reason: The quoted Kunneth Statement supplies the external cup product but does not supply A~T. Its proof step 1.2 does establish that comparison, so the mathematics is available; the contract citation is incomplete rather than a false theorem. Added direct AW/shuffle and cup-definition citations and the explicit coboundary J(A-T)=delta(JH), without PID, freeness, or AC.

The collar domains have dimension n+1 and map onto open collar neighbourhoods, not the n-dimensional boundary faces. The same original paragraph already uses the zero-slice diffeomorphisms correctly, so this is nonfatal inaccurate wording. F1 and step 1.1 now state those interfaces exactly. Boundary vanishing and finite component additivity give w[M0]+w[M1]=0 and -p[M0]+p[M1]=0; degree zero and inherited AC are unchanged.

The external-sum normal orientation differs by (-1)^(ns) from the normal-first orientation for the product tangents. Multiplying both source and fibre orientations by that sign cancels in their quotient and cannot repair the tangent orientation. The proof now computes products at cofinal even normal ranks and verifies compatibility under two-plane stabilization, where every intervening block permutation has positive determinant. Statement unchanged.

F1 supplies surjectivity and bordism invariance, but its quoted Statement does not assert the normal-differential comparison invoked in old step 1.2. Its full proof step 2.2 does prove that comparison, so this is an incomplete interface citation, not a false inverse. The repaired proof instead establishes a well-defined transverse-preimage beta using stable common levels and the exact relative-homotopy supplier, checks beta alpha=id on classified collapses, and uses surjectivity to conclude alpha beta=id.
